company.name: Association for Women in Computing @ UMD

positions.title: Global Technology Intern
positions.description:
Developed team communications and information for Stand-up meetings.
Researched, designed, and implemented scalable applications for information identification,
extraction, analysis, retrieval, and indexing.
Developed Spring Boot programs using programming languages such as Java.
Developed code fixes and enhancements for inclusion in future code releases and patches.
Gathered and documented requirements for projects.
Documented business processes and analyzed procedures to align with changing business
needs.
Developed Communications metrics derived from raw company data to track improvements
in operational excellence.
Volunteered my time to the Bofa Girls Who Code Program.
Mentored Teenage Girls on studying in the computer field.
Used development tools such as Java, Spring Boot, and Postman on a regular basis.
Learned to solve challenging algorithmic problems in order to better understand the need for
time complexity awareness when coding for Big Data.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Interned in the Engineering Department as a CAD and programming Intern. Learned more about the application of code in systems. Spent time in a traditional office setting learning about blue printing and basic mechanical engineering.

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
-Learned basic computer science skills in a classroom setting. 
-Was taught leadership, networking and developing skills. 
-Was mentored by women from the Bank of America Corp on the day to day of working in the STEM field.
